title: Passiflora incarnata tea for medicinal use
intro: Passiflora incarnata tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and flowers of the passionflower plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its calming effects and is often recommended for managing anxiety and insomnia. The tea is believed to promote relaxation and can help ease symptoms of nervous tension. It is typically prepared by steeping the dried plant material in hot water for several minutes. In traditional and modern herbal practices, it is valued as a natural remedy for stress-related conditions.
